{{Quote|Mack, what's going on back there?!|Unidentified pilot to Mack|audio=MackWhatsGoingOnBackThere-TheGunganGeneral.flac|<ref name="tgg" />}}
A '''[[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]]''' served during the [[Mission to Florrum/Legends|Mission to Florrum]], and [[Death/Legends|perished]] during the mission.

==Biography==
[[File:BothPilotsAreDead-TGG.png|thumb|left|250px|The pilot, and co-pilot, Mack, are found dead after crashing on Florrum.]]
The pilot was operating a [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttle]] alongside another [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], [[Mack/Legends|Mack]]. The purpose of the mission was simple; since it was confirmed by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] that [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], the [[Head of State/Legends|leader]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], was in the custody of [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's pirate gang]], [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Kharrus/Legends|Kharrus]] and [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] would land on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]], take Dooku back to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for trial while the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] would get one million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] worth of [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. Unfortunately, a revolting pirate named [[Turk Falso/Legends|Turk Falso]] wanted all the spice for himself. To do this, he used a [[Flarestar-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Flarestar''-class Weequay ship]] to shoot down the shuttle. Although the unidentified pilot and Mack easily avoided the laser fire, Jar Jar Binks accidentally pressed a button on the shuttle. Designed to bring pilot's down via an elevated chair for quick access to the cockpit. The pilot suddenly found himself up out of the cockpit and near Jar Jar. After briefly chatting with the representative, the trooper ordered him back into his seat. Afterward, the pilot was back in the cockpit, but it would all be for naught; Turk Falso launched [[Homing missile/Legends|homing missiles]], and neither Mack nor the pilot could shake the projectiles and both missiles forced the craft down. The unidentified pilot, Mack, and Senator Kharrus died in the crash.<ref name="tgg" />
